``` {python}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
import numpy as np
from palmerpenguins import load_penguins
```

The data being manipulated in this post is from the Palmer Penguins dataset, loaded in from base R.

``` {python}
#| fig-cap: "Table 1: Palmer Penguins Data Loaded In"
penguins = load_penguins()
penguins.head()
```

``` {python}
#| fig-cap: "Table 2: Average Bill Length and Depth by Penguin Sex"
penguin_mean = penguins.groupby("sex").mean(numeric_only=True)[['bill_length_mm', 'bill_depth_mm']].round()

column_mm = {'bill_length_mm': 'Bill Length [mm]', 'bill_depth_mm': 'Bill Depth [mm]'}

penguin_mean = penguin_mean.rename(columns = column_mm)

penguin_mean.head()
```

``` {python}
#| fig-cap: "Table 3: Average Body Mass by Penguin Species"
penguins['body_mass_lb'] = (penguins['body_mass_g'] / 453.592).round().dropna()
penguin_mass = penguins.groupby(by = "species").mean(numeric_only=True)[["body_mass_lb"]].round(2)

column_mass = {'body_mass_lb': 'Body Mass [lb]'}

penguin_mass = penguin_mass.rename(columns = column_mass)

penguin_mass.head()
```
